notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW - A Roguelite Where the Island Hunts for You!
notes.notes:
We are happy to share that the [b]Wild Light: Darkest Isles DEMO is available NOW![/b]
Survive unforgiving nights as you explore the island, set up camp, and slay the Ancient Chief Titan in this preview. [b]But beware, the longer you survive, the darker the nights become
[/b]
We will be updating our demo as we go, so we'd love to hear your feedback for any modes, characters, or changes you'd like to see. Let us know in our discord (https://discord.gg/7dxxJjJ) we are always online and would love to have a chat!
